concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it writes multiple output files (checksums, power analysis report, scaffold counts, splits, filtered dataset). Running it in parallel with any downstream consumer could read partially‑written artifacts, violating data‑flow safety.
Task T010 is also marked `[P]` yet it executes the *entire* pipeline (T001–T009). This inherently depends on all prior artifacts and cannot be safely run in parallel with any other task.

Task T011 carries the `[US1]` tag, grouping it with T002 and T004 under User Story 1. However T011 generates figures that require model performance and diagnostic outputs produced by later tasks (T005, T008, T009). Therefore the US1 block is not an independently‑shippable unit.

Task T013 amends the specification to reduce scope to logP and to update FR‑005/SC‑003. It appears *after* tasks that already assume the original spec (e.g., T008 expects Bonferroni correction). The amendment should precede any task that depends on the revised spec to avoid mismatched requirements.
Task T007 depends on the combined feature matrix (`combined_features.csv`) produced by T004, but T004 is listed *after* T007 in the ordering table. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer dependency.
